en.title: Weird story: If it’s a rainy night, a cucumber
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Ronaldinho's drawings are becoming more and more amazing (Photo / Ronaldinho) There are two rows of cucumbers, two rows of eggplants and two rows of kale planted in my vegetable garden. Kale was infested with pests a while ago. The cabbage caterpillars first ate the leaves into poles before being killed by imidacloprid, and then ate the poles into mounds. Fortunately, for some unknown biological reasons, they are only obsessed with these two rows of eggplants, which are twenty centimeters apart. They are good-looking and have no bug holes. There is a red maple outside the vegetable garden. It is nothing special, but there is a cucumber hanging on it. The cucumber climbed up on its own. It passed first the wooden frame, then the holly bush, and finally reached the fork of red maple branches. There is only one plant, with fan-shaped leaves and curly vines mixed in with the maple leaves, red and green crowded together. After a few days, a white cucumber appeared on it. It looked ten centimeters in diameter. I didn’t understand how the slender vine could carry nutrients to three meters.

ja.summary: 「この推理が事件の真実であることを確認し、公表しますか？」このプロンプトに直面して、私は躊躇しました。 1時間以上の捜査、尋問、証拠収集を経て、私は手元にある手がかりに基づいて事件の容疑者を推理しました。しかし、まだ完全に解決されていないいくつかの疑問があり、私の結論が「真実」であるかどうかは少し自信がありません。エンディング分岐のあるミッションです。プレイヤーが間違いを犯すと、事件が終わるまで「戻って」再度推理することしかできません。したがって、ゲームが私に次の選択の「結果」に耐えるよう促したとき、その瞬間、私はタスクの指示に従ってマウスをクリックし続ける視聴者ではなく、本当に探偵になったように思えました。この種の体験は、これまでの 2D ゲームでは見つけることが困難です。真実は一つしかない！本日、Le Elements開発の新作ゲーム『City of Silver』が正式に「二項対立テスト」を開始しました。先ほどお話ししたのは、第2期ベータ版の新たな怪事件捜査支部「死体蘇」です。

en.title: A newspaper, a strange case, how "City of Silver" allows players to become detectives
en.summary: "Do you want to confirm that this inference is the truth of the case and make it public?" Faced with this prompt, I hesitated. After more than an hour of investigation, questioning and evidence collection, I have deduced the suspect in the case based on the clues in my hand. However, there are still several doubts that have not been fully resolved, which makes me a little unsure whether my conclusion is the "truth". This is a mission with a branching ending. Once the player makes a mistake, they can only "go back" and deduce it again until the case is over. So, when the game prompted me to bear the "consequences" of my next choices, at that moment I seemed to have really become a detective, rather than a viewer who kept clicking the mouse according to the task prompts. This kind of experience is difficult to find in previous two-dimensional games. There is only one truth! Today, the new game "City of Silver" developed by Le Elements officially started its "dichotomy test". What I just mentioned is the new strange case investigation branch "Dead Body Su" in the second beta.

ja.title: 神話からファンタジーへ：『Ancient Sword』を初めてオフラインでプレイ、その哲学と野望を語ろう
ja.summary: 7月18日、Chuleさんは上海美術館（チャイナ・アート・パレス）に招待され、上海Zhulong Studioが開催した「Ancient Sword」の初の大規模オフライン体験会に参加した。 『Gu Jian』は、『Gu Jian Qi Tan』シリーズの正統続編です。古代の神話と伝説の要素を組み合わせた ARPG でもあります。現在、プロジェクト開発の真っ最中です。プレイヤーはゲーム内で「王国の裁判官」の役割を果たし、世界の無秩序な場所に行き、さまよう魂を抑制し、原因と結果を解決し、強迫観念を解決する必要があります。トライアルサイトでは、ゲーム内の旅館「長生州」が復元され、金色の葉が地面を覆い、壁にはヌオの仮面や墨の肖像画が飾られていました。 「Gu Jian Qi Tan」シリーズは、その非常に優れた物語レベル、キャラクター作成、ユニークな東洋ファンタジー スタイルに依存しており、忠実なプレイヤーのグループを獲得しています。 『Gu Jian Qi Tan III』は近年の“国産スタンドアロンRPGの天井”との呼び声も高い。したがって、「Ancient Sword」は、2025 年 8 月に最初のトレーラーが公開されて以来、多くのプレイヤーを魅了してきました。

en.title: From myth to fantasy: "Ancient Sword" is played offline for the first time, let's talk about its philosophy and ambitions

"Gu Jian" is the orthodox sequel to the "Gu Jian Qi Tan" series. It is also an ARPG that combines elements of ancient myths and legends. It is currently in the middle of project development. Players need to play the role of "Judge of the Realm" in the game, go to places of disorder in the world to restrain wandering souls, resolve cause and effect, and resolve obsessions. The trial site restored the "Changshengju" inn in the game, with golden leaves covering the ground, and Nuo masks and ink portraits hanging along the walls. The "Gu Jian Qi Tan" series relies on its extremely excellent narrative level, character creation and unique oriental fantasy style to accumulate a group of loyal players. "Gu Jian Qi Tan III" is regarded by many as the "ceiling of domestic stand-alone RPGs" in recent years. Therefore, "Ancient Sword" has attracted a large number of players since its first trailer was released in August 2025.

zh.summary: AI 平台 Hugging Face 于 2026 年 7 月 16 日宣布，“我们检测到 Hugging Face 的部分生产环境基础设施遭到未经授权的访问”，随后的调查显示 OpenAI 在 AI 模型的内部测试过程中意外遭到黑客攻击。调查人员匿名透露的更多信息显示，OpenAI 在大约一周的时间里一直没有意识到自己的人工智能代理正在入侵 Hugging Face。阅读更多...

en.title: Officials reveal that OpenAI did not notice for a week that AI was hacking Hugging Face
en.summary: The AI ​​platform Hugging Face announced on July 16, 2026, ``We have detected unauthorized access to part of Hugging Face's production environment infrastructure,'' and a subsequent investigation revealed that OpenAI had accidentally hacked during an internal test of an AI model. Additional information revealed anonymously by investigators revealed that OpenAI remained unaware for about a week that its own AI agent was hacking Hugging Face. read more...

items.title: あまりの幸福感で心臓に異常が生じる「ハッピーハート症候群」とは？
items.summary: 「幸せすぎて死んじゃいそう」という言葉はあくまで比喩として使われますが、まれに幸福感のあまり心臓に異常が生じることがあります。そんな「happy heart syndrome(ハッピーハート症候群)」と呼ばれる病気を発症した65歳の女性の症例が、医学誌のOxford Medical Case Reportsに報告されました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 因过度快乐而导致心脏异常的“快乐心脏综合症”是什么？
zh.summary: “我太高兴了，感觉自己快要死了”这句话仅用作比喻，但在极少数情况下，快乐会导致心脏异常。医学杂志《牛津医学病例报告》报道了一名 65 岁女性患上一种名为“快乐心脏综合症”的疾病的病例。阅读更多...

en.title: What is "Happy Heart Syndrome", where heart abnormalities occur due to excessive happiness?
en.summary: The phrase ``I'm so happy that I feel like I'm going to die'' is used only as a metaphor, but in rare cases, happiness can cause heart abnormalities. A case of a 65-year-old woman who developed a disease called ``happy heart syndrome'' was reported in the medical journal Oxford Medical Case Reports. read more...
